title: 签约了
content_zh:
经过这么久的努力，九幽的书终于签约，这几个月的时间，让九幽很是感慨。

    从最初的只有几个人看，每天点击量只有十多个，到现在每天有了稳定的阅读量。从之前的签约不过，到现在的签约过了。这一路走来，谢谢大家的支持，九幽在这里向大家说些谢谢了。没有你们的支持，我是没法坚持到现在的。

    小说已签约了，九幽也会更加努力，努力使故事更加完善，更加合理。

    其实或许大家也都看出来了，前期有着许多无法解释的地方，这不是小说的BUG，而是一切为了后面的一丝铺垫，随着天古星故事的发展，到后面的诸天星辰，茫茫星河，一切真相都会慢慢浮出水面。

    请大家放心，签约不是九幽洋洋自喜的资本，而是更加努力创作的鞭策。

    九幽会一如既往，更加努力的写作，不会让大家失望的。还是那句话，只要还有一个人在看九幽的小说，九幽就会更加努力的写下去。

    谢谢大家。

    《诸天星神》签约了 正在手打中，请稍等片刻，

    内容更新后，请重新刷新页面，即可获取最新更新！
content_en:
After so long efforts, Jiuyou's book was finally signed. These past few months made Jiuyou very emotional.

    From the beginning, there were only a few people watching it, and there were only a dozen clicks per day, but now it has a stable number of reads every day. From the previous signing, which was no good, to the current signing, which is great. Thank you for your support along the way. Jiuyou is here to say thank you to everyone. Without your support, I wouldn't be able to persist until now.

    The novel has been signed, and Jiuyou will work harder to make the story more complete and reasonable.

    In fact, maybe everyone has noticed that there are many unexplainable things in the early stage. This is not a bug in the novel, but a hint of foreshadowing for the rest of the story. As the story of Tianguxing develops, and the stars in the sky and the vast galaxy behind, all the truth will slowly emerge.

    Please rest assured that signing the contract is not a source of complacency for Jiuyou, but a spur to work harder to create.

    As always, Jiuyouhui will work harder to write and will not let everyone down. Again, as long as there is still one person reading Jiuyou's novel, Jiuyou will work harder to write it.

    Thank you all.

    "All Star Gods" has been signed and is being downloaded. Please wait a moment.

    After the content is updated, please refresh the page to get the latest updates!
